Q1 Who can post a manual journal entry, and does the system require an approval?
Dana Whitfield, Controller
Marisol and I post. The approval step in the system is off; whoever approves types their name in the Approved by field. Jordan approves mine when I ask him.
Q2 Entry 26-01253 (AJ-26-0605, over and under billings) was posted on Sunday, July 5, 2026. Why?
Dana Whitfield, Controller
Friday July 3 was the holiday. I closed June over the weekend so the subledgers could close on Monday the 6th. The entry is the June 30 contract schedule’s over and under billings.
Q3 Entry 26-01261 (AJ-26-0633, $48,000.00 to Pier 9 revenue) was posted on Saturday, August 8, 2026 at 9:41 PM, after the August 3 close, and reverses on July 2. What supports it?
Dana Whitfield, Controller

The Pier 9 project manager told me June work on the CO-07 hold-downs was not in the schedule. I booked it so June revenue matched what he expected and set it to reverse until his estimate came in. I do not have the estimate yet.
Q4 Entry 26-01259 (AJ-26-0631, the $26,900.00 depreciation true-up) shows you as preparer and approver. Why?
Dana Whitfield, Controller
Jordan was out that week. It lowered expense to agree with the register, so I approved it myself.
Q5 Were you asked to approve any FY2026 year-end entries, and are you aware of any entry made outside the normal process?
Jordan Hale, Chief Financial Officer
I was not asked to approve any year-end entries. I am not aware of any entry outside the normal process. I did not know about the August 8 entry.
Q6 Is there pressure on the FY2026 results, from the bank or anyone else?
Jordan Hale, Chief Financial Officer
The bank tests the covenants on the June 30 statements, and the officers watch the margin on Pier 9. The compliance certificate went to the bank on August 10.
